headline: Open models, tested in the open
lede: Prompts, ComfyUI workflows and findings from hands-on projects with AI models you can run yourself, published exactly as they ran, with the failures left in.
about: Loop Forge is a hobby project testing open-weight AI models in ComfyUI, by someone with no background in film making. Video so far, and every project gets a page here with the prompts, workflows and settings it used.
The house rules: every clip plays uncut, every prompt is published exactly as it was sent to the model, and the parts that did not work stay in.
rig: RTX 3060 with 12GB of VRAM, i5-13400F, 32GB of RAM
RTX 5090 on RunPod, for higher resolution runs of the same prompts
ComfyUI, with stock templates unless a page says otherwise
